section_damage._doc: M10-T08 (D12.5, Q53): how a capital's sections take damage. reactor_overload: share of a reactor's points it takes after it shuts down before it blows; pass_on: share of a hit on a lost section passed to the nearest live section; headless_fire_rate: rate of fire on last orders after the bridge is lost; power_stage_at and power_stage_level: below this share of its points a reactor gives this share of power; mount_reach_m: a hit this close to a live mount (or within its barrel's length) lands on it too.

mount_hit_points._doc: M10-T08 (Q53, docs/assets-capital.md 'Sections, mounts and blasts'): a mount's own hit points, by its weapon's kind (data/capitals/loadouts.json), else by the hardpoint's kind.
